name: Fluke
author: ESC_CODE
description: A generative sequencer that plays the current synth or sampler. It writes a melody in one of six scales and ten styles, which you shape live with Length, Density or Euclidean Pulses, Rotate, Rate, Direction and Swing. Lift saves a pattern so you can wander off and Drop back to it.
credits: an integer adaptation of Mutable Instruments Marbles by Emilie Gillet (MIT)
